text: 金十数据9月18日讯，艾华集团公告，公司拟向不超过35名（含本数）的特定投资者发行A股股票，募集资金总额不超过人民币18.8亿元（含本数），其中15亿元用于艾华集团一体化高端电容产能扩建项目，3.8亿元用于补充流动资金。本次发行尚需股东会审议通过、上交所审核通过并经中国证监会同意注册。
text_en: Jinshi Data, September 18 - Aihua Group announced that the company plans to issue A-shares to no more than 35 (including this number) specific investors, with total funds raised not exceeding RMB 1.88 billion (including this number), of which RMB 1.5 billion will be used for Aihua Group's integrated high-end capacitor production capacity expansion project, and RMB 380 million will be used to supplement working capital. This issuance still needs to be approved by the shareholders' meeting, approved by the SSE, and registered with the consent of the CSRC.
